deck_title: Crank-Nicolson Cayley unitary wave propagator vs naive backward Euler numerical damping rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic John Crank & Phyllis Nicolson (1947) / Arthur Cayley (1846) unitary bilinear wave propagator (G_CN(theta) = (1 + i*theta/2) / (1 - i*theta/2), whose complex-conjugate numerator and denominator lock single-step wave energy |G_CN|^2 = 1.0000x across all 17 phase steps theta = omega*dt in [0.0, 2.0]) versus naive implicit backward Euler (G_BE(theta) = 1 / (1 - i*theta), whose artificial numerical viscosity dissipates energy as 1/(1+theta^2) down to 0.8000x at theta=0.50, 0.5000x at theta=1.00, and 0.2000x at theta=2.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-substep RK4 wave integration.
